findings.message: The new `reviewColumn` closure inside `activate` reads the editor groups and passes them to `chooseReviewColumn`, and its result decides where the review pane opens (line 733). No test reaches it: its testsReaching is empty. The only test touching this wiring, review-wiring.test.ts, uses `read`/`code` helpers that look like source-text checks, not a run of the closure. So what the closure actually does is not exercised: mapping the groups, passing CHAT_VIEW_TYPE, and the cast to vscode.ViewColumn.

`chooseReviewColumn` has an empty testsReaching. But the Story adds review-column.test.ts, whose `group(viewColumn, isActive, ...tabs)` helper builds EditorGroupView fixtures for this function. A test is most likely present and the graph just lacks the test-reach edges for this new file. This is present but failing/unverified, not a missing test. No build record confirms it passes, so run review-column.test.ts to confirm it reaches and passes against chooseReviewColumn.
